notes:
Venture 0.19 — commands that arrive, and files that come back

• The flight bar now waits for the aircraft to acknowledge a command and
  resends until it does. RTL, LAND and the emergency disarm were sent once and
  never checked, so a command the aircraft never heard looked exactly like one
  it obeyed — the slider closed, the pill went back to rest, and nothing said
  otherwise. A refusal and a silence are now told apart and reported, and every
  mode the aircraft actually enters is recorded in the status log, so "did the
  RTL take?" can be answered afterwards on the ground.
• The confirm slider can be finished. It asked for three and a half inches of
  unbroken travel and sent nothing at all if you fell a little short or let go
  early — which is what "the emergency disable would not disarm" was, with the
  aircraft armed on the ground and the radio never involved. It is now about an
  inch and a half and completes if you release past three quarters.
• A mode change is checked against the aircraft's own heartbeat, not just
  against its reply. Accepted and flying it are different claims, and they come
  apart when something takes the mode straight back.
• REVIEW takes observation files off an SD card: browse the card, choose one
  file, send it to the core. Cards are noticed going in and coming out. A card
  the controller cannot read now says so, instead of looking exactly like an
  empty slot, and folders belonging to the operating system are hidden.
• The review screens show the base station for a flight — station, distance and
  fix count — and say whether the flight is corrected. Playback now covers the
  seconds that hold returns rather than every second of the flight, and a frame
  that fails to load says so instead of leaving the previous one on screen.
• The terrain profile has a way out. It was drawn over its own BACK button.
• Volume: Configuration > Controller > Volume. Ten steps, and each one plays as
  you set it, so it can be chosen by ear rather than guessed at indoors.
• The battery in the top corner shows a bolt while the controller is charging.
• Maintenance has moved: the unmarked five-second hold is now on
  Configuration > COMPASS, not on the home screen's cards.

With the matching system image, three things change that this APK cannot do on
its own: USB debugging stays off unless someone has just turned it on, and lasts
only until the unit is power cycled; the status bar no longer shows Android's
own battery and clock during boot; and MTP shows the Venture folder alone rather
than the whole device. Flash the image and the APK together — the USB debugging
change depends on MTP working, and an older image does not have that fix.
